title: flow-gate-batcher-kv-compactness-heuristic
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem: Streaming chat workloads frequently create many short-lived KV entries and microbatches that drive GPU memory fragmentation and cause OOM headroom loss under mixed-priority traffic. Goal: Implement a flow-gate batch formation heuristic that 1) reduces transient KV retention by compacting low-value prefixes, 2) coalesces microbursts with near-zero added latency for conversational clients, and 3) respects per-GPU soft memory budgets to avoid allocation spikes. This ticket scopes design + prototype + benchmark of the heuristic and an A/B evaluation on the staging cluster.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end P95 token latency for streaming chat at baseline load does not regress by more than 10ms compared to current staging baseline.
Steady-state GPU memory per pod reduced by at least 15% under the mixed conversational workload used for our standard perf suite.
Observed KV slot churn (create+evict rate) decreased by >=20% on average during 1m peak spikes.
No decrease in user-visible completion quality for the provided eval prompt set (quality regression <= 0.5% measured by reference eval harness).
Feature gated behind runtime flag and rolloutable per-cluster; unit/integration tests and feature toggle present in the PR.
tasks: Design shorthand: flow-gate = a per-session soft timer + compactness score that delays low-priority microbatches up to X ms to enable coalescing
Implement compactness score calculation: uses prefix-length, token-entropy, recent-token-variance, and priority tag to rank KV entries for pinning vs compaction
GPU memory budget API: expose per-pod soft_budget and current_usage to batcher scheduler; add spill-on-threshold policy to trigger aggressive compaction
Microbatch coalescer: add microburst window 12-40ms with a jitter multiplier that prioritizes low-latency sessions; ensure streaming flush semantics preserved
KV compactor: implement lightweight in-process compaction that merges small contiguous slots into compact store and marks compressible entries for quantized eviction
Benchmark harness: add scenario to perf-suite (conv-mix-2k users, 50% streaming, 25% high-priority) and baseline runs for comparison
Safety hooks: add telemetry for compaction decisions (why an entry was compacted/pinned) and rollback toggle
PR + code review: iterate with runtime and infra; include integration test on staging cluster with canary rollout
risk_mitigation: Risk: Over-eager compaction may increase cache misses for active sessions. Mitigation: conservative initial thresholds + quick rollback flag + canary ramp to 10% of traffic.
Risk: Added scheduling latency harms tail latency. Mitigation: per-session latency budget where high-priority sessions bypass flow-gate; low-priority get longer coalescing windows.
Risk: Complexity in KV store invariants. Mitigation: start with read-only compaction mode (mark + virtual compact) before physical merge; fuzz tests for cache correctness.
Risk: GPU allocation spikes during compaction. Mitigation: bounded compaction work per tick and spread background compaction across GPUs; respect soft_budget parameter.
metrics: p50/p95/p99 token latency (streaming) - per-cluster and per-model
